CVE-2023-46604.title: Apache ActiveMQ Remote Code Execution
CVE-2023-46604.remediation: Upgrade Apache ActiveMQ to version 5.15.16, 5.16.7, 5.17.6, 5.18.3 or later.

CVE-2024-21626.title: runc Container Breakout / Privilege Escalation
CVE-2024-21626.remediation: Update runc package to version 1.1.12 or newer on all container hosts.

CVE-2023-38606.title: OpenSSH Terrapin Prefix Truncation Attack
CVE-2023-38606.remediation: Disable vulnerable ChaCha20-Poly1305 and CBC ciphers in sshd_config.
